newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech shares hit by Agrobanka crisis.
newsitem.headline: Czech shares hit by Agrobanka crisis.

text.p: The major indices on the Prague bourse fell sharply on Monday with both highly capitalised shares and broader issues mainly down.
The PX50 lost 9.1 points to 556.7 and the RPIX fell 16 to 1,129.

Analysts said the market was feeling the knock-on effect of last week's crisis at the largest fully private Czech bank, Agrobanka, in the form of a lack of interest in equities from both domestic and foreign investors.

"There is a lack of interest in general from both foreign and domestic investors. From the foreigners the lack of interest is caused by the bank crisis," said Miroslav Nosal of Patria Finance investment bank.
Nosal added that he expected no immediate rebound in the market and was bearish about its short term prospects.
"I do not expect a significant improvement or any news that could help the market in the next few sessions," he said.
With the exception of power utility CEZ, the major issues all moved decisively lower.

SPT Telecom, which did not trade after the morning price fixing, lost 50 crowns to 3,310. Savings bank Ceska Sporitelna was the biggest loser among the market heavyweights with a 19 crown, 5.6 percent, decline to 321.
Komercni Banka also fell hard, losing 34 crowns, 1.5 percent, to 1,350.
Activity was low with turnover at just 618 million crowns
